svg.title: Four silent changes between the file and the tensor
svg.desc: A JPEG file becoming a NumPy array of shape 240 by 320 by 3 in BGR uint8, then four stacked blue transformation arrows for channel order, axis order, dtype and normalization, each annotated in red with the bug that skipping it produces, ending in a 3 by 224 by 224 float tensor; below, a five-by-five grid of numbers with a red three-by-three kernel window over its corner producing the value 16 in a three-by-three feature map, with the multiply-accumulate written out longhand.
svg.text: Four silent changes between the file and the tensor
forget it and the model sees blue blood: -3.4 pts
shape error - at least this one crashes
forget and activations are 255x too big -> nan
wrong constants = a slow, silent 1-2 pts
four independent changes. Get any one of
them wrong and the model still runs -
three of the four fail SILENTLY.
operation. Everything else in a CNN
and where the epoch time actually goes
...and if the bottleneck is the disk itself? -> Layer 3
